title: H2O, B3LYP/6-31G orbitals through the rebuilt-Fock path
description: Kohn-Sham orbitals as an orbital source. The stored KS matrix carries exchange-correlation and is not the HF Fock operator, so this entry must go through the rebuilt-Fock path and must fail loudly if it is sent to the stored-Fock path.

solver.notes: Small enough for exact diagonalisation, so this entry doubles as the truth source for the solver adapters.

provenance.geometry_source: gaussian/probe_h2o_rhf.gjf, the committed M0 probe job.
provenance.notes: The correlated energy here is not expected to match the RHF-orbital result; what is being checked is that the Hamiltonian is the HF Hamiltonian in KS orbitals, not a KS Hamiltonian.
